option_relations.rationale: Lymphangioma does not match the clinical and histological findings presented in the vignette.

Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma (Dabska tumor) matches the clinical and histological findings presented in the vignette, including the presence of promontory signs and hemosiderin deposits.
Benign lymphangioendothelioma (BLAE) matches some of the clinical and histological findings presented in the vignette, including the presence of vascular proliferation and hemosiderin deposits.
Pseudo-Kaposi’s sarcoma (acroangiodermatitis) does not match the clinical and histological findings presented in the vignette, including the absence of cellular pleomorphism and mitotic figures.
